fields.availabilityStatus: Current overlay enum; unknown when no overlay is present.
fields.eligibleFeatureFamilies: Step 14-approved exact position/target signal scopes; no numeric contribution implied.
fields.eliteProbability/starterProbability/bust: Null because no calibrated 2026 probability output is available.
fields.expectedGames: Unadjusted 17-game schedule baseline; not an injury-adjusted model output.
fields.fullPprPointsP10/fullPprPointsP90: Null because no approved distribution bounds are available.
fields.fullPprPointsP50: Same frozen consensus center as projectedFullPprPoints.
fields.modelConfidence: Transparent source-governance confidence grade, not an outcome probability.
fields.projectedFullPprPoints: Frozen consensus standardized_full_ppr_points; universal full-season center.
fields.quarantinedFeatureFamilies: Binding mechanism, H_ALL, and incomplete scopes excluded from live numeric use.

null_policy: Null means unavailable/not defensibly produced; null is never converted to numeric zero.
